about: Reviewed country overrides for World Discovery Map pins (future_saints/countries.py). Each entry is used only when a pinned site's slug AND title both match. Everything else follows the point-in-polygon rule. See docs/future-saints/map-calibration.md, 'Country borders and names'.

overrides.why: The basilica is inside Vatican City, but its coordinates fall 0.1 km from Natural Earth's simplified Vatican outline, so the point-in-polygon rule treats it as on the border.

overrides.site_title: Tomb of St. John Paul II (St. Peter's Basilica)
overrides.why: Inside St. Peter's Basilica, in Vatican City; the coordinates are the basilica's, 0.1 km from Natural Earth's simplified Vatican outline, so the point-in-polygon rule treats them as on the border.

overrides.site_title: St. Peter's Basilica (Tomb of St. Gregory the Great)
overrides.why: Inside St. Peter's Basilica, in Vatican City; the coordinates are the basilica's, 0.1 km from Natural Earth's simplified Vatican outline, so the point-in-polygon rule treats them as on the border.
Bethany (al-Eizariya) is in the West Bank, shown as Palestine; its coordinates are within 1 km of the line with Israel, so the point-in-polygon rule treats them as on the border.
